ops.text: P6 SWEEP GROUND-TRUTH + USER DECISION (middle path). The lane ran the native aggregators on real fixtures and broke the plan premise: activity_lift/query_session are LOSSY (metrics/booleans, not the rich Turn.events/ToolUse.call graph); the graph is load-bearing for evidence.py/context/render/mining; watch/discovery had no dead legs (already 100% native); the 4,000–4,500 LOC target is unreachable without new Rust bindings. Lane completed the decision-independent set meanwhile: 10 commits — literals inversion, show/NOISE specs→core, command.py 627→48 facade (tree-sitter fully out of Python), cost→native (pricing= dropped, CHANGELOG'd), facts→native path-based, render raw-renderers→native (rich stays), context capture→raw-bytes native, backend.py deleted, runtime deps dropped (click/aiosqlite/anyio→dev/tree-sitter×2; orjson stays — deep runtime consumers), surgical docs-ref fixes via fragments. LOC 10,185→9,217; full battery green. USER PICKED THE MIDDLE PATH (AskUserQuestion): activity/query stay Python as the idiomatic structuring layer (rich-view port declined), but three small bindings ride the P3 mine_events &Entry boundary — the lane's 'no event→bytes serializer' blocker was a false constraint, views cross natively without serialization: (1) post-parse keep_events/labels_for → filterspec post-parse leg + mining/filterspec die; (2) events-in windowed notification replay (STOP-and-fallback clause if core is raw-line-coupled); (3) buckets events-in (uuids/indices out, facade rehydrates). mining/formats callable legs survive as inherently-Python. Bonus wave: render.py's P5-orphaned CLI helpers (~80–100 LOC) + dangling parity comments die. Expected landing ~8.3–8.6k LOC. One review + one landing after the wave. Flake #27 did not recur all session.
